verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a hosted product-data API, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no region or residency choice: it shows only a single production server (api.trychannel3.com) and no residency settings. Community remarks about the catalog being US-only concern product coverage, not where customer data is stored, so they do not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
